summary.one_liner: NemoClaw is an open source NVIDIA reference stack for running supported AI agents (OpenClaw, Hermes, LangChain Deep Agents Code) inside NVIDIA OpenShell sandboxes, with guided onboarding, managed inference, and network policy controls.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes NemoClaw as a reference stack for running supported AI agents more safely inside NVIDIA OpenShell sandboxes. It offers guided onboarding, managed inference, network policy, managed integrations, OpenShell-backed state persistence, and lifecycle operations through the NemoClaw CLI and agent-specific aliases. The installer offers an express mode that installs OpenClaw by default, or an interactive mode to choose the agent, sandbox name, inference provider, and model. On Hermes connections from a light terminal, it may install a managed Hermes skin and removes it when no longer needed. A contributor setup script (scripts/dev-setup.sh) prepares a source checkout, with optional CLI exposure and sandbox runtime validation. Detailed capabilities, architecture, and security controls live in external documentation that the README links to rather than describes.
use_cases: run AI coding agents in a sandbox
set up OpenClaw, Hermes, or Deep Agents safely
control network egress for AI agents
how_to_run: Review the Prerequisites page in the NemoClaw documentation before installing.
Run the installer in your terminal and choose express install (Y) or interactive setup (n).
For contributors: ./scripts/dev-setup.sh to prepare a source checkout without creating a runtime sandbox.
Add --expose-cli to dev-setup.sh only if a host-visible development CLI is needed.
Add --with-runtime to dev-setup.sh only when sandbox validation is needed.
notable: Sandboxed execution of supported AI agents via NVIDIA OpenShell
Network policy with baseline rules, operator approval flow, and egress control
Guided onboarding with express and interactive install modes
Managed inference provider configuration and routed inference
Agent-specific CLI aliases and coding-agent starter prompt for installation
caveats: Described as an alpha project; maintainers respond on a best-effort basis with no guaranteed timelines
Prerequisites are platform-specific; express install preset is for supported DGX or WSL hosts
Priorities are not a delivery commitment or fixed roadmap
